description: This file defines the AsyncTimer class, an internal implementation of a timer mechanism within the Orleans.Runtime namespace. It manages asynchronous timing operations, checks health status based on timing overshoot, and includes logging capabilities.

classes.name: AsyncTimer
classes.description: An internal asynchronous timer class that supports timing, overshoot detection, and health checks within Orleans runtime.

methods.name: NextTick
methods.description: Returns a task that completes after a specified delay, either the configured period or an override. Handles task cancellation and calculating overshoot.

methods.name: CheckHealth
methods.description: Checks if the timer has fired correctly based on expected firing time, reports reasons if not.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Cancels ongoing timer operations and resets internal state.
